WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mth::DATE) AS month_num
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
first_36 AS (
    SELECT * FROM monthly_data WHERE time_step <= 36
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        f1.product_id,
        f1.time_step,
        f1.month_num,
        f1.qty,
        AVG(f2.qty) AS cma
    FROM first_36 f1
    JOIN first_36 f2 ON f1.product_id = f2.product_id
        AND f2.time_step BETWEEN f1.time_step - 5 AND f1.time_step + 6
    WHERE f1.time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    GROUP BY f1.product_id, f1.time_step, f1.month_num, f1.qty
),
raw_seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_num,
        AVG(CAST(qty AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(cma, 0)) AS raw_factor
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE cma > 0
    GROUP BY product_id, month_num
),
normalized_seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_num,
        raw_factor / AVG(raw_factor) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS seasonality_factor
    FROM raw_seasonality
),
deseasonalized AS (
    SELECT 
        f.product_id,
        f.time_step,
        CAST(f.qty AS DOUBLE) / ns.seasonality_factor AS deseasonalized_qty
    FROM first_36 f
    JOIN normalized_seasonality ns ON f.product_id = ns.product_id AND f.month_num = ns.month_num
    WHERE f.qty > 0 AND ns.seasonality_factor > 0
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        REGR_SLOPE(deseasonalized_qty, time_step) AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(deseasonalized_qty, time_step) AS intercept
    FROM deseasonalized
    GROUP BY product_id
),
forecast_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        r.product_id,
        f.time_step,
        f.mth,
        ROUND((r.intercept + r.slope * f.time_step) * ns.seasonality_factor, 2) AS forecast_sales
    FROM first_36 f
    JOIN regression r ON f.product_id = r.product_id
    LEFT JOIN normalized_seasonality ns ON f.product_id = ns.product_id AND f.month_num = ns.month_num
    WHERE f.time_step BETWEEN 25 AND 36
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(annual_forecast), 2) AS average_forecasted_annual_sales
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, ROUND(SUM(forecast_sales), 2) AS annual_forecast
    FROM forecast_2018
    GROUP BY product_id
)
